items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: John Corbett went back and found, looked under every rock and stone and found every painting that I darn near ever did in my life.

ctx.x: What is the medium that you work in?

Well I had some crossover things from when I was doing oils so I finished those up, but I’m doing acrylics now. Because I don’t want to breathe all of the oils and all this kind of thing like that anymore. So yeah I’m using acrylics and I use a brush and then also I use these pens you know, because they’re almost like drawing. Yeah, yeah. So that’s what I’m doing. But of course but John Corbett went back and found, looked under every rock and stone and found every painting that I darn near ever did in my life.…
Well it’s a nice, sort of continuing the circle that perhaps your uncle started with his crayons.
